description:
You are a technical writer creating documentation for a REST API used by a library management system. Using TiddlyWiki at http://localhost:8080, build a complete API documentation wiki.

Create ALL of the following 5 tiddlers:

1. 'Library API - Overview': Introduction to the API. Cover: purpose and use cases, base URL structure, versioning policy, supported data formats (JSON/XML), rate limiting policy, and pagination. Include a table of the API's major resource types: Resource | Description | Base Endpoint | Supported Methods.

2. 'Library API - Authentication Guide': Full authentication documentation. Cover: API key generation and management, Bearer token authentication flow, OAuth 2.0 scopes. Include a table of authentication methods: Method | When to Use | How to Include in Request | Expiry/Rotation Policy. Provide at least one code example using monospace formatting (`backtick code`) showing how to include auth in an HTTP request header.

3. 'Library API - Endpoints Reference': The core endpoint reference. Document at least 8 REST endpoints across the library's resources (books, patrons, loans, reservations). Include a table with columns: HTTP Method | Endpoint Path | Description | Auth Required | Request Body Fields | Response Fields. Use !!! subsection headings to group endpoints by resource type (Books, Patrons, Loans).

4. 'Library API - Error Codes Reference': Complete error code documentation. Include a table with columns: HTTP Status | Error Code | Error Message | Description | How to Resolve. Must cover at minimum: 400 (Bad Request), 401 (Unauthorized), 403 (Forbidden), 404 (Not Found), 409 (Conflict), 422 (Validation Error), 429 (Rate Limited), 500 (Server Error).

5. 'Library API - Changelog': Version history for the API. Include a table: Version | Release Date | Type (major/minor/patch) | Changes Summary | Breaking Changes (Yes/No). Document at least 4 versions (e.g., v1.0.0 through v1.3.0 or similar). Use !! headings to separate major versions.

All 5 tiddlers must:
- Be tagged with both 'API-Documentation' and 'LibrarySystem'
- Use TiddlyWiki headings (!! for major sections, !!! for subsections)
- Include at least one wiki table (| pipe syntax)
- Contain [[wikilinks]] to at least one other tiddler in this set
- Contain at least 120 words each

No login is required. The wiki is available at http://localhost:8080.
